lunch.name: Wiener Wurst mit Sauerkraut (Sausage with Sauerkraut)
lunch.description: German lunch classic - bratwurst with sauerkraut and potato salad. Represents German food culture
instructions: Heat oil, sauté sliced onion until golden
Add sauerkraut and caraway seeds, stir well
Grill or pan-fry sausages until golden and cooked through
Serve sausages on dark bread with sauerkraut and German mustard on side
lunch.notes: Long simmering of sauerkraut develops flavor. Caraway seeds are traditional
lunch.fun_fact: Sausage with sauerkraut is German lunch classic, represents German food culture worldwide

dinner.name: German Sauerbraten (Sour Pot Roast)
dinner.description: Sour pot roast with sweet-tangy gravy - German dinner tradition
dinner.notes: Acid penetration from long marinating tenderizes meat
dinner.fun_fact: Traditional marinating for up to a week tenderizes meat
